Hey Cherry Kiss Fans!

It’s time to talk about the best day in April that no one talks about...IT’S BANANA DAY! Yes, Banana Day where we celebrate...the banana, and all things that look like it, so Happy Banana Day!

To celebrate we’re hosting the biggest ever Banana Day sale by turning a day into a week! From April 15th - April 21st we’ll have some of our best titles featuring our characters who have..uhh... big bananas! Check out these deals:


50% Nympho Monster Domination
25% Aristocunts 
50% Deviant Dungeon 
35% Elf Breeding Farm 
35% Hot & Steamy Knights 

But wait, there’s more! We’re also hosting a Banana Bundle!

Purchase the Banana Bundle for an additional discount featuring the following games:


 Aristocunts 
 Deviant Dungeon 
 Elf Breeding Farm

We’re so happy to be able to celebrate this special week with you and we can’t wait to show you what we have cooking up for summer!

Stay home, stay safe, and celebrate the almighty banana!

Happy Banana Day!

Love,
